JSON 备份、恢复与跨环境迁移。: JSON backups, restoration and migration between environments.
用于数据备份，以及 beta 与正式版之间的店铺业务数据迁移。金额和时间保留原值: Back up shop data or migrate between beta and production. Stored amounts and times remain unchanged.
跨环境迁移时，请先停止旧环境营业，核对导入结果后再在新环境营业，避免两边同时计费: For migration, stop operations in the old environment and verify the import before reopening in the new environment to avoid billing in both.
业务备份（玩家、余额、账单和配置）: Business backup (players, balances, bills and configuration)
备份不含网页登录账号关联、登录凭据、Bot 凭据或设备连接；导入后需重新绑定和配: Backups exclude web account links, login credentials, Bot credentials and device connections. Reconnect accounts and devices after import. Files contain player identities and financial data; keep them secure.
支持当前版本 PRiSM 导出的 JSON，最大 10 MiB。: Supports JSON exported by this PRiSM version, up to 10 MiB.
导入完成，请检查计费设置并重新配置设备与接入凭据。: Import complete. Review billing settings and configure devices and integration credentials.
将来源店铺的业务数据导入当前空店铺。: Import the source data into this empty shop.
仅导入空店铺，保留目标店铺的名称、位置、时区、封面和管理员。: Import only into an empty shop. Its name, location, time zone, cover and administrators are preserved.
不包含网页登录账号关联、登录凭据、Bot 凭据或设备连接；导入后需要重新绑定和配: Web account links, login credentials, Bot credentials and device connections are excluded. Reconnect accounts and devices after import.
业务备份包含玩家平台身份、卡片标识及财务数据，请妥善保管文件。: Business backups contain player platform identities, card identifiers and financial data. Keep the file secure.
只有店铺负责人可以导入和导出数据: Only shop owners can import and export data
请选择有效的 JSON 备份文件: Choose a valid JSON backup file
备份文件超过 10 MiB 限制: The backup exceeds the 10 MiB limit
数据超过当前导入导出容量限制，请联系管理员进行数据库备份: The data exceeds the current transfer limit. Contact an administrator for a database backup.
计费数据库结构不完整，无法恢复历史版本: The billing database schema is incomplete; historical versions cannot be restored
导入操作尚未完成: The import is not yet complete
数据关联或约束校验失败，导入已全部回滚: Data references or constraints failed. The entire import was rolled back.
目标店铺已有玩家、账单、配置或设备，请选择空店铺导入: The target contains players, bills, configuration or devices. Choose an empty shop.
备份包含设备连接密钥、玩家身份和财务数据，请妥善保管。跨环境账号通过已验证的登录: Backups contain device connection secrets, player identities and financial data. Keep them secure. Account links are restored through verified login identities; passkeys, OAuth secrets and login sessions are not copied.
支持 PRiSM v1／v2 JSON 备份，分片传输，无 10 MiB 文件大: Supports PRiSM v1/v2 JSON backups with chunked transfers and no 10 MiB file limit.
prism-neo 导出（pg_dump 文本或 JSON 快照）: prism-neo export (pg_dump text or JSON snapshot)
支持 prism-neo 的 pg_dump 备份（.sql）或 CLI 导出的: Supports prism-neo pg_dump backups (.sql) or CLI JSON snapshots, converted to a PRiSM backup in the browser before upload. Legacy billing rules import as disabled; review their time zones in billing settings before enabling.
导入完成，请核对玩家、余额、账单及设备设置后再营业。: Import complete. Verify players, balances, bills and device settings before reopening.
导出文件没有玩家，请核对来源环境和店铺。: No players were exported. Check the source environment and shop.
将恢复完整店铺资料、设置、设备连接及业务记录。目标店铺编号和当前管理员保留。: Restore the full shop profile, settings, device connections and business records. Keep the target ID and current administrator.
备份包含连接密钥、平台身份、卡片和财务数据，请妥善保管。: The backup contains connection secrets, platform identities, cards and financial data. Keep it secure.
账号按同一账号 ID 或已验证登录身份恢复关联；无法匹配的关联保留，需重新绑定。: Restore account links by the same account ID or a verified login identity. Unmatched links are retained and require rebinding.
单次传输分片过大，请缩小分片后重试: The transfer chunk is too large. Retry with a smaller chunk.
备份任务不存在或已过期: The backup task does not exist or has expired.
分片编号对应的数据已变化: The content for this chunk number has changed.
备份中存在重复标识或分片状态发生变化: The backup has duplicate identifiers or the chunk state has changed.
备份文件未完整上传或数据表不完整: The backup upload or table manifest is incomplete.
导入账号关联存在冲突，请联系店主处理: The imported account links conflict. Contact the shop owner.
单条记录超过数据库可支持的大小: A record exceeds the database size limit.
备份记录数量不一致，请重新导出: The backup record count does not match. Export again.
已完成导入不能撤销: A completed import cannot be undone.
多个账号关联使用了同一登录身份: Multiple account links use the same login identity.
平台绑定与玩家身份不一致: The platform binding does not match the player identity.
计费设置与文件摘要不一致: Billing settings do not match the file summary.
前台玩家不可拥有余额资产: Cashier players cannot have balance assets.
此为 v1 备份，仅恢复文件已有内容，目标店铺资料保留。: This is a v1 backup. Only the data present in the file is restored, and the target shop profile is retained.
网页登录身份缺少对应的账号关联: A web login identity is missing its corresponding account link.
每店每月可导出一次，需要更多次数请联系平台管理员。开始导出即使用次数；导出期间暂: Each store can export once per month. Contact the platform administrator for more exports. Starting an export uses one allowance. Store operations pause during export and resume after completion or cancellation; a disconnected export unlocks within 5 minutes.
店铺正在导出数据，暂时不能进行业务操作，请稍后重试: This store is exporting data. Business operations are paused; please try again later.
本月导出次数已用完，需要更多次数请联系平台管理员: You have used this month’s export allowance. Contact the platform administrator for additional exports.
默认每月一次。额外次数仅对店铺当前月份有效，不影响下月默认额度。: One export per month by default. Extra exports apply only to the store’s current month.
导出锁已过期，请联系平台管理员重试: The export lock has expired. Contact the platform administrator to retry.
店铺有正在处理的业务操作，请稍后再导出: The store has a business operation in progress. Try exporting again shortly.
每店每月可导入一次，需要更多次数请联系平台管理员。开始上传即使用次数，同一任务内: Each store can import once per month. Contact the platform administrator for more imports. Starting an upload uses one allowance; retries within the same task do not use another.
导入、导出分别默认每月一次。额外次数仅对店铺当前月份有效。: Each store gets one import and one export per month. Extra allowances apply only to the store’s current month.
本月导入次数已用完，需要更多次数请联系平台管理员: You have used this month’s import allowance. Contact the platform administrator for additional imports.
营业额不包含已归档账单；消费笔数等其他统计保持不变。: Revenue excludes archived bills. Session counts and other statistics remain unchanged.
归档会隐藏账单并从营业额中排除；玩家记录、余额和其他统计不变。恢复后重新计入营业: Archiving hides this bill and excludes it from revenue. Player records, balances and other statistics stay unchanged. Restoring includes it in revenue again.
恢复此账单后，营业额将增加 {amount}。: Restoring this bill will add {amount} to revenue.
归档此账单后，营业额将减少 {amount}。: Archiving this bill will remove {amount} from revenue.
业务备份将覆盖目标店铺现有数据，而不是追加。: A business backup replaces existing shop data instead of adding to it.
将覆盖同编号配置并补充新配置，保留玩家和账单。: Overwrite matching configuration and add new configuration, retaining players and bills.
我确认覆盖目标店铺现有数据，并已保留所需备份: I confirm replacing the target shop data and have saved the backups I need
请确认覆盖目标店铺现有数据: Confirm replacing the existing target shop data
请先完成覆盖导入数据库迁移: Complete the overwrite import database migration first
业务备份将替换目标店铺现有玩家、余额、账单和计费配置；此操作不能撤销，请先保留原: Business backups replace the target players, balances, bills and billing configuration. This cannot be undone; save the original shop backup first.
仅配置导入会覆盖同编号配置并新增文件中的配置和设备，保留玩家、余额、账单及其他配: Configuration imports overwrite matching configuration and add configuration and devices from the file, retaining players, balances, bills and other configuration.
将恢复店铺资料和设置，并覆盖或新增配置及设备；目标店铺编号和当前管理员保留。: Restore the shop profile and settings, and overwrite or add configuration and devices. Retain the target shop ID and current administrator.
逐行填写 Session 的开启时间、关闭时间和计费方案；最早开启为入场时间，最: Enter each session's start, end and pricing plan. The earliest start is admission; the latest end is departure. Sessions may overlap.
时间使用店铺时区: Times are entered in the shop time zone
按当前启用的计费规则和全局封顶模拟，不包含余额、优惠券及既往消费历史；不会生成真: Simulates with currently enabled plans and global caps. Excludes wallet balances, coupons and past billing history; no real bill is created.
请先启用至少一个计费方案。: Enable at least one pricing plan first.
改价会记录在账单调整项中，结账时将按新金额扣费。: The override is recorded as a bill adjustment. Checkout will debit the revised amount.
充值将进入充值余额，并与结账原子提交；实际账单及余额会在提交时重新校验。: The top-up is added to the paid balance and committed atomically with checkout. The amount due and funds are checked again at confirmation.
充值金额不足以支付当前账单: The top-up would leave insufficient balance for the current bill.
开启一项即配置一种能力，可同时开启多项。: Turn on any capability you need. Several can be on at once.
按键码使用 Windows Virtual-Key Codes，例如 32 是空: Key codes use Windows Virtual-Key Codes; 32 is the space bar.
TTLock 账号在「设置 → 位置与设备」中连接。: Connect the TTLock account under Settings → Location and devices.
还没有启用中的计费规则，请先在「计费」页创建。: No pricing rule is enabled yet. Create one on the Pricing page first.
启用入场计费后即可选择麻将计费规则。: Enable entry billing to choose mahjong pricing rules.
请至少选择一条麻将计费规则。: Choose at least one mahjong pricing rule.
启用设备（停用后玩家扫码无法使用）: Device enabled (a disabled device cannot be scanned)
用逗号分隔，例如 mai、舞萌: Separate with commas, e.g. mai, 舞萌
按座位开桌计时，与计费规则联动。: Time play by seat and apply the mahjong pricing rules.
通过 TTLock 生成一次性开门密码。: Generate a one-time door code through TTLock.
玩家刷卡启动机台、投币，或由机台直连本平台。: Players swipe to start machines and insert coins, or the machine connects straight to this platform.
通过 Home Assistant 读取并开关机台电源。: Read and switch machine power through Home Assistant.
页面发生错误，请刷新重试。若问题持续，请联系管理员。: Something went wrong. Reload to try again, and contact an administrator if it keeps happening.
玩家和 Bot 可以用任意一个别名找到这台设备。: Players and bots can find this device by any of its aliases.
请先补全标记为「待配置」的能力。: Complete the capabilities marked “Needs setup” first.
入场计费需要至少一条按时计费的规则。: Entry billing needs at least one time-based rule.
封顶金额需要大于 0: The cap must be greater than 0
每隔分钟数需要大于 0: The interval must be greater than 0 minutes
还没有可计入封顶的规则。: No rules are available to include in the cap yet.
这是唯一一次显示，离开后无法再次查看。: This is the only time it is shown; it cannot be viewed again after you leave.
把这两行写入 hinata.ini 或 segatools.ini 的 [aim: Write these two lines into the [aimeio] section of hinata.ini or segatools.ini, then restart the machine.
我已写入机台: I wrote it to the machine
请先签发设备令牌，或改为外部中继。: Issue a device token first, or switch to an external relay.
轮换后机台上的旧令牌立即失效，需要把新令牌重新写入 INI。: Rotating invalidates the token on the machine immediately; the new one has to be written to its INI.
设备已停用，操作不可用。: The device is disabled, so actions are unavailable.
玩家充值得到的钱，结账时扣除: Money a player tops up; deducted at checkout
券或次数，按用途发放: Coupons or counts handed out for a purpose
选择左侧玩家查看余额、资产和计费: Pick a player on the left to see balance, assets and billing
将对 {count} 位玩家逐个结账。: Each of the {count} selected players is checked out individually.
导入到空店铺，确认后恢复数据。不会覆盖已有玩家、余额或账单；目标店铺的名称、位置: Import into an empty shop and restore after confirmation. Existing players, balances and bills cannot be overwritten. The target shop retains its name, location, time zone and administrators.
文件检查通过，确认后即可导入。: The file passed its checks. Confirm to import.
文件检查未通过，请处理上述问题后重试。: The file failed its checks. Resolve the issues above and try again.
店铺数据或文件已变化，请重新导入: The shop or file changed. Start the import again.
导入到空店铺，确认后恢复来源店铺的资料、设置和业务数据，保留目标店铺编号和当前管: Import into an empty shop and restore the source profile, settings and business data after confirmation, retaining the target ID and current administrator.
文件已上传完成，不能继续修改: The file has finished uploading and can no longer be modified.
文件检查时上传状态发生变化，请重试: The upload changed while the file was being checked. Try again.
数据校验失败，导入已全部回滚，请重试: Import validation failed. All changes were rolled back. Try again.
文件尚未上传完成: The file has not finished uploading.
任务状态不允许重新检查文件: The task state does not allow re-checking the file.
业务备份覆盖现有数据；仅配置备份保留玩家和账单。目标店铺编号和当前管理员保留。: Business backups replace existing data; configuration backups retain players and bills. The target shop ID and current administrator are retained.
